name: Desktop Essentials
description: A starting layout for desktop navigation: left stick moves the pointer, right stick scrolls vertically and horizontally, D-pad provides arrow keys, face buttons provide clicks and shortcuts, and shoulders also scroll. See the assignments below for your controller's button names.

name: Browser Essentials
description: A starting browser layout: left stick moves the pointer, right stick scrolls vertically and horizontally, face buttons provide clicks, the address bar and find, shoulders also scroll, and the D-pad provides history and tab navigation. See the assignments below for your controller's button names. Works at the browser application level.

name: Star Trek Online - PS5-style (PC)
description: Console-inspired template for default PC bindings: 1 Space, 2 Ground, 3 Menus. Space: left stick flies the ship; right stick looks around automatically while deflected, without a camera-button hold. Ground requires STO Shooter mode: enable it in the game (default keyboard B switches RPG/Shooter). Left stick moves; right stick looks/aims directly. Left trigger is Aim (X), right trigger primary fire (left mouse), right shoulder secondary fire (right mouse). Bottom face button jumps; right face button and D-pad/left-pad Up interact (F). No crouch binding; right stick click is unassigned on Ground. Menus uses pointer controls. Reserve Create / Share (SDL button 4) in a GameClient.exe Applications rule to cycle only Space/Ground/Menus. Other powers use numbered tray slots; arrange them in STO. Console radial menus and ability automation are not reproduced. Steam models use SDL3; avoid simultaneous Steam keyboard/mouse emulation. Hardware and gameplay are untested. Requires Bifrost 0.1.11 or newer; 0.1.12 bundles these defaults. Update profiles, reapply, and save/export again for existing App rules. Existing personal and saved mappings remain unchanged.

name: Desktop - Steam Controller (2015)
description: Physical Steam Controller (2015) desktop navigation. Left stick moves the pointer; right touchpad scrolls because this model has no right stick. Gyro and other available inputs can be customized in Controllers. Keep Steam from also generating keyboard/mouse input. Hardware behavior is untested.

name: Minecraft Java - PS5-style (PC)
description: Java Edition only. Bedrock already offers native controller support. Uses PC movement, mouse look, attack/use, hotbar scrolling and inventory shortcuts. In the inventory layout, the right stick moves the cursor; inventory navigation remains the Java mouse interface. Console-inspired starting template, not exact console parity. Keyboard movement is digital; right stick provides mouse look/pointer. Disable competing keyboard/mouse mappings and use PC keyboard/mouse input for this alternative. Layouts switch manually: create an App rule for the actual game executable, select only these named sets and reserve Create / View / Back (SDL index 4). This button is unassigned in all layouts. No automatic in-game state detection. Hardware/gameplay untested.
